audit.head: f33c8392e163ac37814bb4e7cefdd5c229e89812
audit.basis: Working-tree source inspection and explicitly listed read-only probes; not a hardware certification or complete master-plan implementation.
audit.instructions: No AGENTS.md found in checked ancestors or recursive repository/reference searches.
audit.reference_policy: User-deleted PedroPathing-main tree remains deleted. Surviving reference is read-only.

status_vocabulary.SOURCE_CONFIRMED: Observed in inspected source; does not imply execution success.
status_vocabulary.PROBE_PASS: Only the stated bounded probe ran successfully.
status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: Not tested or independently established in this audit.

coordinate_contract.public_chassis_pose: inches and degrees by default; getPose(true) returns radians
coordinate_contract.spline_state: meters; heading counterclockwise from +X; converted by XDRIVE LTV adapter
coordinate_contract.simulator_pose: inches and clockwise degrees; plant velocities in SI; controller feedback converted to SI

notes: main.cpp supplies five null OdomSensors pointers, including IMU; config/robot.json imuPort is null.
Chassis::calibrate creates motor-backed vertical tracking-wheel wrappers, not additional physical sensors. XDRIVE odometry reads all four motor positions directly.
Drivetrain uses width+wheelbase as turning span and sqrt(2)*physical wheel diameter as effective translation diameter.
Motor groups are explicitly green in main.cpp; changing cartridgeRpm in JSON alone does not change this constructor.

nodes.role: Nominal shared geometry, signed ports and legacy chassis gains; generated artifacts are checked with --check.
nodes.limits: Cascade Q/R, wheel gains and most plant constants are not all supplied by this JSON. drive and imuPort do not create hardware in main.cpp.

nodes.role: PROS lifecycle, driver input, diagnostics, routine selection and public autonomous wrappers.
nodes.limits: Routine named Pedro Bezier invokes BezierReference and the cascade, not PedroFollower::follow.

nodes.role: Quintic point time law, sampled arc-length Bezier reference, quintic spline trajectory generation.
nodes.limits: Bezier heading is independent of tangent; spline heading is tangent-derived. Spline speed/acceleration/jerk checks are tangential, not full chassis feasibility.

nodes.role: Task lifecycle, trajectory validation/interpolation and conversion into followReference for XDRIVE.
nodes.limits: Separate differential-drive Eigen LTV and two-wheel VelocityController branch remains present but is not selected by current main.cpp.

nodes.role: Reference-linearized discrete Riccati outer pose controller -> X-drive inverse kinematics -> four wheel PI plus feedforward voltage loops.
nodes.limits: Derivative support exists but wheelKd defaults to zero. Gain caching and nominal gains are not physical tuning evidence.

nodes.role: 10 ms scheduled reference loop, odometry epoch checks, motor RPM feedback, timeout/cancellation and 150 ms settle dwell.
Four signed motor encoder positions -> X-drive displacement -> midpoint field integration -> filtered pose velocities and status snapshot.
nodes.limits: No independent absolute position/heading sensor configured. Slip is not observable as absolute error from these encoders alone; stale/discontinuity faults latch until rebase.

nodes.role: Exclusive lease, mode/disabled checks, finite-value guards, voltage limits, PROS output errors, release/stop and 100 ms write watchdog.
nodes.limits: Watchdog is called by the odometry task, not an independent safety task. Robot scheduling/failure latency is UNVERIFIED.

nodes.role: Library alternatives and optional subsystems; not the selected feedback/control path in main.cpp.
nodes.limits: PedroFollower is constructed and cancelled, but no follow call is wired in main.cpp. File presence does not establish sensor fusion or algorithm parity.

nodes.role: Motor monitor task plus LCD pose/status/routine telemetry.
nodes.limits: Not a substitute for independent localization or hardware-in-loop verification.

nodes.role: Compile shared controller/reference code to WASI reactor; 64-double buffer and explicit exports connect JavaScript feedback to C++ volts.
nodes.limits: Shares algorithms, not PROS main, odometry, drive leases or runtime scheduling. JS step supplies valid=true after array-shape checks.

nodes.role: Original shared approximate motor/contact/rigid-body plant, encoder odometry and action scheduler; browser rendering and source-checked headless scripted reach benchmark with seeded episodes and measured reward.
nodes.limits: Legacy JS controller classes remain, but executeAction uses ProductionControl. Display EKF is not controller feedback.

nodes.role: Game state/rules approximation, collision proxies, reduced object dynamics and four independent WASM-controlled robot simulations.
nodes.limits: Standalone VM plant probes omit these modules. Game rules, collision fidelity and hardware equivalence are UNVERIFIED in this audit.

nodes.role: Firmware/WASM build scripts, mocked production boundary tests and standalone simulator regression suites.
nodes.limits: control-core.test.js writes docs/recovery/control-results.json; it was not run unchanged because that file is outside audit ownership.

audit_checks.scope: Existing header and JS match generator output; no files written.
All 10 LF-normalized SHA-256 source hashes and the WASM byte hash match control-build.json.
WebAssembly.Module.imports lists only WASI fd_close, fd_seek and fd_write; no clock/random imports.
Two fresh standalone simulations in one process, each 1000 updates of 0.01 seconds and a 24-inch forward action: selected per-step trace JSON exactly equal; both report Settled.
Two cubic control-point sets at six parameters each: local WASM value/first/second derivatives agree with Bernstein formulas within 1e-4. Not a Java Pedro comparison.

handoffs.request: Test actual odometry and PROS sensor failure semantics, reset epochs, slip observability and scheduling latency; no implementation performed here.
Add explicit sensor packet/fault boundary and reproducible input traces; validate plant constants against measured robot data.
Choose geometry-only reuse versus a Foresight port; use pedro_mapping.md before claiming equivalence.
Run scoped regression/build/bench gates and attach provenance; do not treat this audit as completed master-plan acceptance.
